description: PLATEAU's C02 bridge fixture read and written back with uro and urf 3.1 listed in adeSchemas: the uro:lod0Geometry surface inside the bridge's id-less uro:DmGeometricAttribute is written inside that element, after uro:shapeType where the i-UR XSD puts it, instead of being dropped for want of a brid:lod0Geometry. The reader keys the element so its geometry can be told from the bridge's own. The case ships a validation.xsd so check-citygml-schema validates it against i-UR. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens nested objects.
